resources.name: Open-source DFT package (e.g., ORCA 5.x or PySCF)

access.notes: Must support geometry optimisations and single‑point energy calculations with B3LYP, 6‑31G**, GD3BJ, and constraints on dihedral angles.
Included with DFT code or obtainable from the Basis Set Exchange.

access.notes: Used to create initial 3D coordinates from SMILES or chemical knowledge. Not mandatory if coordinates are built manually.
